outcome: Erythropoiesis (hemoglobin, hematocrit, nucleated RBC, mean corpuscular volume, mean corpuscular hemoglobin)
cohort: A total of 160 newborns with prenatally diagnosed CHD from 2013 to 2018, excluding multiple gestations, genetic abnormalities, major extra-cardiac anomalies, and placental abruption.
finding: Term infants with CHD demonstrated multiple alterations in erythrocyte indices, including lower hemoglobin at birth, suggestive of ineffective stress erythropoiesis in late gestation, but these alterations were not correlated with birth anthropometrics or Doppler patterns.
gest_age: Median 38.3 (37.3, 39.0) weeks; infants were analyzed in groups of <34 weeks, 34-37 weeks, and >=37 weeks gestation.
